verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a transactions API for retrieving transactions by card, merchant and account holder, plus webhooks sent as events occur, which gives a real-time view of transaction activity. The MCP server also advertises querying and monitoring payment activity. Most of the finance-lead story is unevidenced; the balance-inquiry mention refers only to sandbox simulation, not a balance view. Missing for 10: account and card balance visibility, a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing record, settlement and reconciliation reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
